p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u072/system/state/workspace/programs/task-73fdb458.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    ink = next(x for x in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if x != bg)
    # Fill cells enclosed by strokes on all four cardinal sides.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and any(grid[r][k] == ink for k in range(c)) and any(grid[r][k] == ink for k in range(c+1,w)) and any(grid[k][c] == ink for k in range(r)) and any(grid[k][c] == ink for k in range(r+1,h)):
                out[r][c] = 4
    # At a T/cross junction, recolor the longer vertical branch and junction.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != ink: continue
            if any(grid[r][k] == ink for k in range(c)) and any(grid[r][k] == ink for k in range(c+1,w)) and any(grid[k][c] == ink for k in range(r)) and any(grid[k][c] == ink for k in range(r+1,h)):
                up = r - max((k for k in range(r) if grid[k][c] == ink), default=-1)
                down = min((k for k in range(r+1,h) if grid[k][c] == ink), default=h) - r
                if up != down:
                    step = -1 if up > down else 1
                    length = up if up > down else down
                    for d in range(length): out[r+step*d][c] = 4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
